citations.assessment: The passage has Yosef bar Abba in the name of Menaḥem, in Ammi’s name, in a case about betrothal for less than a perutah.
Huna bar Yehudah transmits Menaḥem, who transmits Ammi, about abandoning the Torah reading.

holds.raw: ר' מנחם א"ר הונא בר יהודה א"ר יוסף בר אבא
holds.reason: The checked witnesses place Huna bar Yehudah and Yosef bar Abba as reporters of Menaḥem in distinct passages. Neither gives this exact first chain in Heilprin. Preserve it pending a witness.
